intro.title: From a complete solution to a single component.
intro.body: Veranda supports organizations at whatever level fits: adopting the full platform, integrating individual hardware or software components, or building a product of their own on Veranda technology.

models.title: Choose the engagement that fits your product

items.title: Complete Veranda solution
items.body: Reference enclosure, hardware, and software deployed together as a ready-to-run program.

items.title: Hardware integration
items.body: Build the lock and modular board stack into your own enclosure, locker, or access point.

items.title: Software integration
items.body: Connect Veranda's access, scheduling, and event software to your existing systems and apps.

items.title: Platform licensing
items.body: License Veranda technology to add access, monitoring, and automation to your product line.

items.title: White-labelling
items.body: Take a Veranda-powered product to market under your brand, with our platform underneath.

items.title: Custom development
items.body: Co-develop new enclosures, boards, or workflows for requirements nothing off the shelf meets.

items.title: Strategic relationships
items.body: Longer-term partnerships spanning distribution, programs, and joint product roadmaps.

steps.title: Initial discussion
steps.body: Your product, operation, and what you want to achieve.

steps.title: Requirements & fit
steps.body: Which parts of the platform apply, and how.

steps.title: Evaluation
steps.body: Hands-on testing with an Evaluation Kit.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.body: A scoped deployment in real conditions.

steps.title: Integration or deployment
steps.body: Rolling out into your product or program.

considerations.title: What we'll explore together
considerations.body: Every engagement is shaped by a handful of practical questions. We'll work through them with you early, so the evaluation and pilot answer the right ones.

cta.title: Start with an evaluation.
cta.body: Request an Evaluation Kit, or tell us about your product and we'll set up a preliminary partnership discussion.
